reviews.text:
My roofer Mike Parker was so helpful in getting my roof replaced. The insurance company that I have, have declined me in the past but this time with Mike's expertise he talked to the insurance company and was able to get a complete roof replacement for me. Once approved he came back to my home to discuss roof type, color and cost and replacement day. On the day of replacement he arrived at the same time the actual roofers arrived and he was there all day to answer any questions that I might have had while the job was happening. The clean up job was just as perfect as the whole process. And boom I have a new 30 year roof.  Thanks for Everything
Tammy Patrignani
North Richland Hills TX
reviews.author: Tammy Patrignani

reviews.text: On Friday, May 16, 2025, Excel conducted and completed a roof install on my residence. The crew showed up on time and completed the tear down and install in one day. They were supervised by Rick Walton, who stayed on-site the whole day. I was impressed with Rick's level of experience and his ability to answer any questions or concerns. Clean-up was good and thorough. I initially worked with Jessica Meador as part of a bid process which Excel ultimately won. All requested documents were provided in a timely manner. I am very pleased with the quality of work and would have no issue recommending them for roofing work.
reviews.author: Dave Lyday

reviews.text: Mike and Robin helped me through the whole process of getting my roof replaced. They were both very kind and professional at all times. Very detailed in explaining every phase from the inspection to the walk with insurance agent and then on the day of installation they were there making sure the new roof was installed correctly and with the correct color that was selected. I highly recommend Mike Parker and Robin Elmore. I have already recommended Excel Construction to others that need help with their roof replacement.
reviews.author: Steve Eppler

reviews.text: They did a great job replacing our roof! They arrived as I was leaving for work in the morning, and the roof was complete and they were gone by the time I got back home that afternoon. They had cleaned up everything perfectly, I literally could not even tell that anyone had been there. And the roof looked great. Customer service has been wonderful as well. Highly recommend! 👏🏻
reviews.author: Sara Cross

reviews.text:
A Big Thank you to Ms. Jessica. My insurance company would not replace the entire roof which needed replacing. Thanks to Ms. Jessica who worked closely with me. I was able to replace my entire roof at a very reasonable price. Ms. Jessica's team arrived on time. Replaced my roof before the end of the day along with cleaning up and made it look as if no work had been to my home.  Thank yo Ms. Jessica for making everything go so smoothly. Anyone who ask do you know a roofer, I think of Jessica and her team at Excel.They will be returning soon to do the siding.

Bonnie Ramos of Grand Prairie, TX
reviews.author: Bonnie Ramos

reviews.text: Just finished having a new roof installed due to storm damage and worked with two wonderful women, Stacey and Jennifer who were the ultimate in professionalism and customer service! Couldn’t have asked for a better experience with a contractor! Loved that they worked with my insurance company and were hands on all the way to the finish line! 5 stars!
reviews.author: laurapankey

reviews.text: Stacy Strittmatter and her crew did a complete roof replacement for me.  She was very friendly, professional and told me exactly what needed to be done.  The work was checked and completed timely.  I recommend when asked about my roof replacement. Great Job.
reviews.author: Vicky Lee

reviews.text:
Jessica and Stacy from Excel Construction are absolutely fantastic to work with! They took care of everything, and my new roof looks great 👍. They also handled the insurance claim for me!
You will not be disappointed in using their services.
reviews.author: Randy Saleh
